deadline.value: International applicants for Fall: February 15, 2027; acceptance notification by mid-April.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the official pages checked

funding.value: PhD students are fully funded through a combination of GTA, WGRS and supervisor support, with the same model for international students.
funding.quote: Fully funded through a combination of GTA, WGRS, and supervisor support.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold an MSc in Computer Science with at least 75%; most admitted PhD students had over 85%. A BSc holder can apply to the thesis MSc and request transfer to the PhD after three terms.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for admission to the PhD program must possess an MSc degree in Computer Science from a reputable university, college or institute.
